VOLCANIC ASH EXERCISE VOLCEX26 WILL TAKE PLACE ON 18 NOVEMBER 2026 
FROM 0800 UTC TO 1600 UTC.

THE EXERCISE WILL SIMULATE A CONTINUOUS ERUPTION OF VESUVIO VOLCANO 
IN NAPLES (ITALY) VOLCANO ID: 211020, COORDINATE: 4049N01425E, 
ELEVATION: 4203FT (1281M) WITH DISPERSION OF CONTAMINATING ASH 
CLOUDS. DURING THE EXERCISE A NUMBER OF MESSAGES (VONA, NOTAM, VAA, 
SIGMET) WILL BE ISSUED AND WILL START WITH THE WARNING 'EXERCISE 
VOLCEX26 EXERCISE' AND END WITH A WARNING 'EXERCISE - EXERCISE - 
EXERCISE'. UPON RECEIVING THESE MESSAGES, AIRCRAFT OPERATORS SHALL 
NOT TAKE ANY ACTION. ALL EXERCISE ACTIONS AND PROCEDURES SHALL NOT 
AFFECT REAL LIFE OPERATIONS.
